svg.text: OpenMUPP on the YD-CH32V307VCT6 development board (BOARD=ydch32v307)
Probe signals only. 3.3 V targets only: no level shifters. SWDIO is one pin (PC11). Add a 330-470 Ω resistor from PB13 to PC10 (TCK link).
Top view. Pin 1 of P2 and P3 is at the left, at the P4 and USB2 end. Nets from the board schematic V1.0.
• USB2 (bottom left, USB high speed, PB6/PB7): connect the host here. USB1 and the Ethernet jack are not used.
• P4 (SWD of the CH32V307 itself, PA13/PA14): write the firmware here with a WCH-LinkE. Do not connect the target.
• TCK link: connect a 330-470 Ω resistor from PB13 (P3-45) to PC10 (P3-22). Do not connect PC10 to the target.
• Keep the microSD slot empty: PC10 and PC11 are also DAT2 and DAT3 of the card.
